contexts.text: A multitude parched with thirst () = penury of spiritual Knowledges.
Not to thirst () treats of the Lord's Kingdom, where they are in an abundance of all Knowledges and spiritual Truths.
(The thirsty a class of the good.)
With those in the affection of truth, the good longs for truth as a thirsty man does for water.

If anyone thirst, let him come to Me, and drink ()... Thirsty is predicated of those who are in the love and affection of truth; no others can thirst. ( = to long for truth and be instructed. AC 8568:4.) AE 622:4, Explained.
The soul that thirsteth for drink () = a longing for truth.
As when a thirsty one dreameth, and behold he drinketh (). A thirsty one = one who desires to be instructed... AE 750:10, Explained.

Celestial things, that is, the goods of faith, or, what is the same, the works of charity, in which they are, are signified by bringing waters to meet him that is thirsty, and meeting with bread him that wandereth ().
That the Word of the Lord is such that it gives life to him that thirsteth, that is, to him that desireth life... the Lord teaches in .

The reason to come to drink = the affection of truth, is that it involves thirst; for thirst, in the Word, = the having an appetite and longing, thus an affection, for knowing and imbibing truth; and this because water = truth in general.
By one who thirsts, the Angels with man perceive those who from affection long for truth. AC 4958. Explained.
Thirst = a deficiency of truth. AC 6745:end.
To slay her with thirst () = to extinguish all truth. AE 240:5. AE 730:11.

When man is in temptation, he is as it were in hunger for good and thirst for truth; and therefore, when he emerges, he draws in good as a hungry one does food, and receives truth as a thirsty one does drink.
They called those the thirsty to whom they should give to drink.
To faint for thirst () = to be deprived of truth. AC 8568.
The people thirsted there for waters () = an increase of the longing for truth; for to thirst = to desire eagerly and long for, and is predicated of truth. Illustrated.
Not a thirst for waters; but for hearing the words of Jehovah (). A longing to know truth is here described by to thirst.
Ho, everyone that thirsteth, come ye to the waters () evidently = one who longs for the truths of faith. AE 617:10, Explained. AE 840:2.

To him that is athirst I will give from the fountain of the water of life freely () = that one who longs from affection [shall receive] the truth and good of faith. ( = that to those who long for truths from any spiritual use the Lord will give from Himself through the Word all things which conduce to that use. AR 889.)

Everyone that drinketh of this water shall thirst again; but he that drinketh of the water that I shall give him, shall never thirst ()... Not to thirst, here, = that he shall no longer lack truth. In like manner in he that believeth in Me shall never thirst ().
To thirst = to long for truth. Further illustrated.
To thirst and eat = to be informed by the Lord.
To thirst and drink = a longing to know and perceive truth.
Thirst = the deprivation of all things of faith.

They shall hunger no more, nor thirst any more () = that hereafter they shall not lack goods and truths... For thirst is said of wine and of water, (which) = truth. ( = that they shall not lack good and truth, and the derivative happiness. Explained. AE 480.)

That to thirst = to long for from some spiritual use, is because there exists a thirst or longing for the Knowledges of truth from the Word from natural use, and also from spiritual use; from natural use with those who have erudition as their end, and thereby reputation, honour, and gain... but from spiritual use with those who have as their end to be of service to the neighbour from love for him, to seek the good of his soul, and of their own also; and thus for the sake of the Lord, the neighbour, and salvation: to these there is given from the fountain of the water of life... as much truth as conduces to this use. To the rest, truth therefrom is not given, Explained.
Let him that is athirst come () = that he who longs for the Lord's Kingdom, and for truths then, should pray that the Lord may come with light.
That to thirst = to long for truths. Illustrated.
That thirst and to thirst = to perish, from a deficiency of truth. Illustrated.

Jesus said, I thirst () because He had longed for a New Church which would acknowledge Him. ( = that from Divine love He willed and longed for the salvation of the human race. AE 386:30.) ( = Divine spiritual thirst, which is for Divine good and truth in the Church, through which is the salvation of the human race. AE 519:2.)
The hungry and thirsty, in the Word, = those who continually long for truths, and to be perfected by means of them. Illustrated.
The hungry and thirsty () = those who have a longing to know good and truth. AE 386:27.
To die of thirst () = the extinction of truth. ( = desolation from a deficiency of truth from a spiritual origin. AE 342:8.)
To thirst = to long for.
To be hungry and thirsty = to be deprived of the good of love and truths of faith.
To be dried up with thirst = a deficiency of truth.
He that thirsteth for drink = those who long for truths.
To thirst = to believe in the Lord.
To thirst = to long for truth.
The onagers quench their thirst () = the instruction of those in the Church who long for truths.
A land of thirst () = a Church where there is no truth. ( = no truth, but falsity in its stead. AE 730:10.)
I will pour out waters upon him that is thirsty () = to instruct in truths those in the affection of truth.
Thirst = a deficiency of truth.

That man in temptations is so infested by evils and falsities as scarcely to know otherwise than that he is in Hell, is meant by Jehovah led thee through the great and terrible wilderness, of the serpent... and of thirst, where there were no waters ()... Thirst where were no waters = a deficiency and shutting off of truth.
Drink for the soul of the thirsty () = the understanding of truth.
